title: Recoverable Symbols, Unstable Execution: Auditing Internal Pathways and Decision Identity in Visual State Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2611.27715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual features can retain every symbol a task needs while a model built on them still changes its answer when irrelevant parts of the image change. We study this gap in visual state tracking, where a recurrent executor reads a sequence of symbol tiles through a frozen ViT encoder and decides whether a displayed candidate equals the final state. Our diagnostic pairs each input with a donor view that preserves every queried tile, checks with a symbol-supervised decoder that the full symbol chain is recoverable from both feature sequences, and swaps individual internal channels of the same fitted executor in both directions. On 3,526 pairs in which every symbol is recovered in both views, changing the surrounding context lowers the balanced accuracy of a rotary recurrent head by 17.13 points. The loss runs mainly through the input-dependent rotation phase: restoring the original phase repairs 351 of 391 new errors and brings accuracy back

translated_title: 可恢复符号，不稳定执行：视觉状态追踪中的内部路径与决策同一性审计
translated_abstract: 视觉特征可以完整保留任务所需的每一个符号，但建立在这些特征之上的模型在图像中无关部分发生变化时仍会改变其答案。我们在视觉状态追踪任务中研究这一差距：一个循环执行器通过冻结的ViT编码器读取符号图块序列，并判断所显示的候选状态是否等于最终状态。我们的诊断方法将每个输入与一个保留所有被查询图块的供体视图配对，利用符号监督解码器验证完整符号链可从两个特征序列中恢复，并在两个方向上交换同一已拟合执行器的单个内部通道。在两个视图中所有符号均可恢复的3,526对样本上，改变周围上下文使旋转循环头的平衡准确率下降17.13个百分点。这一损失主要经由依赖输入的旋转相位产生：恢复原始相位修复了391个新错误中的351个，并使准确率回升。
tldr: 该论文提出一种诊断框架，证明即使视觉特征中符号信息完全可恢复，循环执行器的决策仍会因图像无关上下文的变化而不稳定，且这种不稳定主要源于依赖输入的旋转相位——恢复原始相位可修复大部分新增错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diagnostic framework showing that even when all task symbols remain fully recoverable in visual features, a recurrent executor's decisions still destabilize under irrelevant context changes, and this instability flows mainly through the input-dependent rotation phase—restoring the original phase repairs most of the new errors.
